data.narrative:
Blykalla is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Janne Wallenius and Peter Szakalos that has raised $60M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a nuclear energy comp universe of 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Valar Atomics, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using $60M in total raised as a proxy for current fair value and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-later-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $114M. This method is grounded in observed venture progression patterns at this stage.

Peer-median valuation cannot be applied reliably due to insufficient narrow comparables. While five same-sector peers exist in the nuclear energy space, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yields fewer than the three minimum datapoints required for meaningful triangulation. A broad cross-sector median would introduce unacceptable distortion given nuclear energy's distinctive capital and regulatory profile.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $97M (low) to $131M (high), centered on $114M. Key uncertainties include the liquidity and stage distribution of the broader nuclear energy peer set, regulatory pathway execution, and whether comparable company multiples adequately reflect frontier deployment risk in this subsector.
